newsitem.title: UK: European cotton sees slowing demand.
newsitem.headline: European cotton sees slowing demand.

text.p: Holiday influences were increasngly curtailing mill demand for raw cotton in several parts of Europe, traders said.
Such enquiry as was in evidence was typicallly directed to supplies available during the early autumn, though some Italian mills apparently have some gaps in inventory requiring prompt delivery.
The level of asking rates for most origins showed little fundamental change, and business generally presented a very routine appearance.
